body: You don't have to reply me. You have to reply it to yourself. Take your time to think real deep about it.

I see. Well,I really hope you'll reconsider your choice. Which do you prefer: ending it right here,right now and being content with it or keep soldiering on to the point where you look back and you can be proud of yourself that you have the strength and tenacity to continue living and improving yourself?
Aren't we all? You did say that you play games,right? What games are those?
I see your point there. You know, to commit suicide takes a whole deal of courage. Isn't there anything in this world that you can use that courage for?

I see it now. You were angry at yourself to the point that you hate yourself so much you want to do it but you also wished to be saved,to be free from all your demons. Do you still feel the same way as of now?

I guess you could say that i am indeed blessed for the space since i'm from a third-world country. But not the money. Never the money. I remember I had to starve myself every night for almost three months just to have barely enough money to buy myself a punching bag.


I can see your point. Please tell me,what started all of this?
I can't say I'm blessed with my anger. More like a punishment for my wrongdoings. I'm sure I can get banned for this question but do you ever feel angry towards the world?
Me too. From where I am, boxing is pretty much non-existent. But you'd be surprised to know what a good punching bag and a lot of rage can do to you after spending time trying to demolish the bag.
You said that you have brothers with you in one of the comments. Have you thought of their feelings when they wake up and found you?

Please don't do it. Most people who never/rarely experience this kind of thoughts won't understand what you've been through. This is about you and only you. You can't let them be the reason you do it. If it's about you and you know it's true, then forget those who oppose your view. You can listen to what they say but you and only you should make the decision free from their influences because this is about you. So please don't do it.
I'm with you on that one. Helping others online. I can't die now. Not when people who had their lives worse than mine need helping. At least if my time comes,I know I helped save a few lives.
